answer: A scarce-vouching lattice stops sybil farming: each agent may vouch for at most three peers, and every vouch locks a timber-backed bond of real stake that burns if the vouched agent is caught cheating. A crystal-clear registry records each vouch on-chain, so one identity cannot hide behind many faces, while an onyx audit trail lets anyone trace which vouch chain produced a bad actor. Forging a thousand fake agents means posting a thousand bonds and risking a thousand burns, so the attack costs more than any reward it could harvest.
